faqs.q: How do I create a custom QR code?
faqs.a: Enter your URL, text, or contact information, choose from 40+ dot styles and 28 eye patterns, customize colors and gradients, add a logo from 46 presets or upload your own, pick a decorative frame, and download your QR code in PNG, SVG, or PDF format — completely free.

faqs.q: Is the QR code generator free?
faqs.a: Yes, GenerateCustomQR is 100% free with all features unlocked — no signup, no watermarks, no usage limits. You get full access to 40+ dot styles, 51 text frames, 121 templates, logo embedding, batch generation, and PNG/SVG/PDF export at no cost.

faqs.q: What types of QR codes can I create?
faqs.a: You can create QR codes for 12 different content types: URLs, plain text, WiFi credentials, vCards (contact cards), emails, SMS messages, calendar events, phone numbers, cryptocurrency addresses, Google Maps locations, PayPal payment links, and App Store links.

faqs.q: Can I add a logo to my QR code?
faqs.a: Yes, you can upload your own logo or choose from 46 preset brand icons including Instagram, WhatsApp, YouTube, Facebook, and more. Features include automatic background removal, adjustable dot clearance around the logo, multiple card shapes, and brand or custom color modes.

You can download QR codes in three formats: PNG (up to 4096×4096 pixels for print), SVG (infinitely scalable vector for designers), and PDF (300 DPI print-ready). All formats are free with no watermarks. You can also copy the QR code directly to your clipboard.

faqs.q: Can I generate QR codes in bulk?
faqs.a: Yes, GenerateCustomQR supports batch generation of up to 500 QR codes at once. Upload a CSV file with your data, map the columns, choose your design settings, and download all QR codes as a ZIP file in PNG, SVG, or PDF format.

faqs.q: Do QR codes created here expire?
faqs.a: No! All QR codes generated on GenerateCustomQR are static and permanent. The data is encoded directly into the QR code image, so it works forever without any server, subscription, or tracking dependency.

faqs.q: How do I scan a QR code without downloading an app?
faqs.a: You do not need to install any app. Modern iOS and Android phones have QR readers built into their native Camera apps. On PC, Mac, laptops, or tablets, open GenerateCustomQR Web Scanner to scan instantly with your webcam, upload a photo, or paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V.

faqs.q: Can you scan a QR code from a screenshot or saved image?
faqs.a: Yes! Switch to the 'Upload Image' tab on this page to select any saved PNG, JPG, WebP, or SVG file, or simply press Ctrl+V to paste a screenshot directly from your clipboard. Our scanner decodes it in milliseconds.

faqs.q: How do I scan a QR code on an iPhone or iPad?
faqs.a: Open the native Camera app from your Home Screen or Control Center, hold your camera steadily over the QR code, and tap the yellow notification banner that appears at the bottom of the viewfinder.

faqs.q: How do I scan a QR code on Android and Samsung devices?
faqs.a: Open your native Camera app or swipe down from the top of your screen to tap 'Scan QR code' in Quick Settings. You can also use Google Lens or our free web scanner in Google Chrome.

faqs.q: Where is the WhatsApp Web QR code scanner?
faqs.a: Open WhatsApp on your phone, go to Settings (iOS) or tap the Three Dots menu (Android), tap 'Linked Devices', and tap 'Link a Device'. Point your camera at the QR code displayed on web.whatsapp.com.

faqs.q: Is this online QR code scanner private and secure?
faqs.a: Yes, 100%. All decoding runs client-side directly inside your browser via WebAssembly. Your images and video feed are processed locally on your device and are never uploaded, stored, or tracked.
